Every free AI model, updated every night
voce: This is the free AI report for the week of 15 November 2026. The best free chat model is 39 points behind the best paid one. Let's see who is on top, what's new, and what you can run at home.

Here are the ten best free chat models, ranked by blind human votes on Arena. In first place, Kimi K3 Max from Kimi (Moonshot), with 1487 points. Then Kimi K3.1 Pro Max, and GLM 5.3 Max. The dashed line is the best paid model.
From fourth to tenth: MiMo V2.6 Pro, 1480; GLM 5.3 Flash, 1475; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Max, 1475; GLM 5.2 Max, 1475; MiMo V2.5 Pro, 1466; GLM 5.1, 1465; DeepSeek V4 Pro High,, 1464.
Of the top 50 chat models on Arena, paid ones included, 7 can be used for free, and 7 have open weights you can download.
One free model entered the leaderboard this week. The highest is Kimi K3.1 Pro Max, at number 24 overall.

Now the best free model in each category. For coding: Kimi K3.1 Pro Max. For vision: GLM 5.3 Flash. For image: Qwen Image 2.1. For video: MiniMax H3. For search: Diffbot Small XL. For agents: Kimi K3.1 Pro Max.
The model of the week is Cola2, from ByteDance-Seed. It has 9 billion parameters. At 4-bit it needs about 8 gigabytes of memory. The smallest home machine that holds it fully is an RTX 40 60.

What can you run at home? On an RTX 30 60 with 32 gigabytes of RAM, the best free model is Gemma 4 26B A4B, at about 49 tokens per second. On an RTX 40 90 with 64 gigabytes of RAM, the best free model is Gemma 4 31B, at about 36 tokens per second. On a Mac M4 Max, the best free model is Gemma 4 31B, at about 19 tokens per second.
Every free model, with sizes and speeds, is on FreeLLMArena, updated every night. The link is in the description. See you next week.
